verdict.rationale: Cua's docs describe named agents with "routines the daemon fires", which suggests the daemon can run tasks non-interactively, probably on a schedule. That is only a single thin mention, with no detail on how schedules are defined. The SDK's programmatic control is a developer building block, not a documented external-event trigger, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented schedule syntax and recurrence options, external event or webhook triggers, in-depth docs on routines, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can schedule a device task or trigger it from an external event, not only run it interactively
